title: Ledger event v1
description: One append-only entry in GitPulse's action ledger. GitPulse is the canonical owner: it holds the resident watcher and the UI. Manvi session logs and DevCouncil traces.jsonl feed it through importers, which go through the same single writer. Additive-only within v1.

id.description: Monotonic cursor, assigned by the writer. Absent on an event being submitted for append; present on every event read back. Consumers page with it.

ulid.description: Stable identity, unique across repos and machines. Lexicographically sortable by creation time, so it orders correctly even when two writers' ids do not.

ts_utc.description: When the action happened, not when it was appended. An importer replaying a transcript sets the original time.

schema_version.description: This contract's version. A reader that does not recognise the value must degrade to displaying the event as unstructured, never drop it and never guess.

repo_path.description: Absolute path of the repository root. Present on every event: the ledger is queried per-repo and globally.

worktree_path.description: Absolute path of the worktree the action happened in, when it differs from repo_path. This is what binds an event to a task, via the worktree binding recorded at checkout.

actor_kind.description: Who acted. `system` is GitPulse itself — importers, catch-up synthesis, background maintenance — and must never be conflated with a human action.

actor_id.description: Which actor: 'claude-code', 'codex', a username. Null when the actor could not be determined; an unattributed event is recorded as unattributed, never guessed.

session_id.description: Agent session or transcript id, when the event came from or could be joined to one.

task_id.description: DevCouncil task id, resolved from the worktree binding. Null when the worktree is bound to no task — which is a real state, not a missing value.

action.description: Dotted action name: 'git.commit', 'git.push', 'file.edit', 'ci.step', 'session.start'. Namespaced by subsystem so a consumer can filter a family without enumerating members.

object.description: What was acted on: a ref, a file path, or a digest of the argv when neither applies.

argv_json.description: The command line as a JSON array string. MUST be redacted before insert, never at display time — see contracts/README.md, Redaction.

outcome.description: `blocked` means the policy gate refused it and GitPulse did not perform it. It is distinct from `failed`, which means it ran and did not succeed.

verdict_json.description: The policy verdict as a JSON string conforming to verdict.schema.json, plus the consumer-side `checked` flag. Null ONLY when no gate decision applies to this event kind — never null to mean 'allowed'. An event whose gate did not run carries a verdict with checked=false.

before_ref.description: Commit the repository was at before the action. Enables replay and 'restore to here'.

after_ref.description: Commit the repository was at after the action.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the action. Null when not measured — which is not the same as zero.

detail_json.description: Per-action payload as a JSON string. MUST be redacted before insert. Shape varies by `action` and is deliberately not constrained here: a consumer reads what it recognises and ignores the rest.
